text:
incident-bot: ALERT: prod /v1/generate p99 latency spike to ~2.8s, error rate ~8% (5xx + gateway timeouts). Pager routed to @mike (oncall).

mike (oncall): ack — I'm looking. dashboards loading. any recent deploys? :eyes:

sara (runtime): I merged a runtime tweak and rolled canary at 18:01 UTC (rev runtime-20260217-rc1). Canary passed basic smoke.

ben (platform): saw traffic ramping at 18:05 across gateway pools. Could be proxy backpressure + slower downstream kernels.

alice (sre): quick checks: edge logs show 504 from proxy->runtime, runtime pods showing elevated CPU on a subset, lots of `accept` latencies.

mike (oncall): paste top logs?

alice (sre): logs snippet:
```
2026-02-17T18:06:12Z proxy-01 GET /v1/generate -> 504 gateway timeout
2026-02-17T18:06:13Z runtime-3 ERROR inference loop stalled token_emit 1200ms
2026-02-17T18:06:14Z proxy-02 502 Bad Gateway upstream reset
```

ben (platform): metric view: p95 jumped from 120ms -> 1.2s, p99 -> 2.8s, error rate from 0.3% -> 8% between 18:03-18:10 UTC.

jess (product): any customer impact? Are important tenant requests failing?

sara (runtime): early look - long tails on large-context requests and the new kernel path seems to stall under certain batch shapes. Might be a regression in the continuous-batching change.

mike (oncall): decision time: mitigate or rollback. Can we quick-fix by routing heavy requests to older variant?

ben (platform): we can pin gateway routing by model-version or route model_id X to stable. Quick action: shift 100% traffic from runtime-20260217-rc1 -> stable-20260216. I can do that now.

mike (oncall): do it. Also prepare rollback if routing doesn't restore SLOs.

ben (platform): running route change...
```
POST https://routing.internal/api/route
{ "service": "runtime", "from": "runtime-20260217-rc1", "to": "stable-20260216", "weight": 100 }
```

ben (platform): route applied. monitoring... :hourglass_flowing_sand:

incident-bot: NOTE: traffic shift to stable-20260216 initiated by ben at 18:12 UTC.

mike (oncall): metrics?

alice (sre): p95 improved to ~180ms within 2m, p99 down to 420ms. Error rate back to ~0.6%. Looks promising.

sara (runtime): thanks. Even though routing helped, I want to roll runtime-20260217-rc1 back from canary to avoid surprise. I'll kick an immediate rollback.

mike (oncall): please run rollback and announce.

sara (runtime): running rollback now:
```
# rollback runtime to stable-20260216
curl -X POST "https://deploy.internal/api/rollback" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"service":"runtime","to":"stable-20260216","reason":"p99-latency-regression"}'
```

deploy-bot: Rollback job accepted. ID: rb-20260217-001. Starting draining of new pods.

ben (platform): health checks passing on stable. Expected steady state in ~3m.

mike (oncall): good. keep watch on downstream queues and kv cache hit rates.

alice (sre): small customer-visible window between 18:03-18:12: approx 1.2k requests failed (mostly 504/502). Impact concentrated on long-context multimodal workloads. No billing discrepancy seen, just transient errors.

jess (product): will notify support to prepare canned response. Tagging high-touch customers who reported errors.

incident-bot: Rollback rb-20260217-001 completed at 18:17 UTC. Deploy revision stable-20260216 now serving.

alice (sre): metrics post-rollback: p95 ~140ms, p99 ~320ms, error rate back to baseline 0.4%. No further 5xx surge.

mike (oncall): closing hot loop. Action items: 1) sara to bisect runtime change and open PR for revert + test coverage; 2) ben to add route-safe toggle for future rollouts; 3) alice to draft incident timeline and spike graphs.

sara (runtime): will bisect and add unit/regression test for the batching path. assigning DRI: sara.

ben (platform): I'll add a short-term guard: model-route fallback when p99 > 1s for >2m.

jess (product): I'll coordinate customer comms. No urgent credits needed but watch for escalations.

mike (oncall): thanks all. filing postmortem draft and tagging: sara, ben, alice. Will mark as Sev2 since limited customer impact but platform regression.

alice (sre): adding raw dashboards and the rollback command to the incident doc.

mike (oncall): closing thread. If anyone sees regression re-open or ping pager. :white_check_mark:
